map.单桩竖向承载力特征值计算与桩数估算（摩擦桩）: Characteristic value of single-pile vertical bearing capacity and pile count estimate (friction pile)
map.单桩竖向承载力特征值 Ra = 桩周总侧阻 + 桩端阻力: Characteristic value of single-pile vertical bearing capacity Ra = total shaft side resistance + pile tip resistance
map.侧阻有效长度逐层截断：l1,eff = min(l1, L)、l2,eff =: Effective side-resistance length is truncated layer by layer: l1,eff = min(l1, L), l2,eff = min(l2, L − l1,eff), l3,eff = L − l1,eff − l2,eff (not less than 0); soil thickness beyond the pile length is not counted in side resistance
map.up = π·d（桩周长），Ap = π·d²/4（桩端面积）: up = π·d (pile perimeter), Ap = π·d²/4 (pile tip area)
map.需要桩数 n = N / Ra（取整，并适当富余）: Required pile count n = N / Ra (rounded up, with an appropriate margin)
map.📖 查看「桩基础承载力计算 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Pile Foundation Bearing Capacity Calculator User Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：桩基础承载力计算: 📚 Deep dive: Pile Foundation Bearing Capacity
map.摩擦桩单桩承载力估算：按桩径、桩长与各土层侧阻/端阻算出 Ra，再由上部荷载确定: Single-pile capacity estimate for a friction pile: compute Ra from the pile diameter, pile length and the side/tip resistance of each soil layer, then determine the pile count from the superstructure load.
map.桩型方案比选：比较不同桩径、桩长下侧阻与端阻的占比，判断以侧阻为主还是端阻为主。: Pile scheme comparison: compare the shares of side and tip resistance under different pile diameters and lengths to judge whether side resistance or tip resistance dominates.
map.桩数初估与布桩：按 Ra 取整并结合承台尺寸、群桩效应与上部荷载留富余，供方案阶: Preliminary pile count and layout: round up by Ra and allow a margin for the pile cap size, group-pile effect and superstructure load, as a scheme-stage estimate.
map.桩径 d=1.2 m、桩长 L=25 m、qp=1200 kPa，土层侧阻 45: Pile diameter d = 1.2 m, pile length L = 25 m, qp = 1200 kPa, soil side resistance 45/60/80 kPa with thickness 10/10 m (the third layer takes the remaining 5 m), superstructure load 12000 kN: up = π × 1.2 ≈ 3.77 m, Ap = π × 1.2²/4 ≈ 1.131 m²; total side resistance = 3.77 × (45 × 10 + 60 × 10 + 80 × 5) = 3.77 × 1450 ≈ 5466.4 kN, total tip resistance = 1200 × 1.131 ≈ 1357.2 kN, Ra ≈ 6823.5 kN (side resistance about 80.1%, tip resistance 19.9%); pile count n = ceil(12000 / 6823.5) = 2, each pile carrying 6000 kN.
map.侧阻与端阻特征值从哪里取？: Where do the side and tip resistance characteristic values come from?
map.由岩土勘察报告或 JGJ 94-2008 经验表给出，应取特征值（标准值需按规范: They come from the geotechnical investigation report or the empirical tables of JGJ 94-2008 and should be characteristic values (standard values must be reduced per the code); the construction method (bored, driven, post-grouted) significantly changes the side resistance.
map.为什么第三层侧阻不用输入厚度？: Why is no thickness entered for the third layer's side resistance?
map.本工具按桩长逐层截断：前两层厚度先扣减，剩余桩长自动归入第三层，超出桩长的土层不: The tool truncates layer by layer along the pile length: the first two layer thicknesses are subtracted first, the remaining pile length automatically goes to the third layer, and soil beyond the pile length does not contribute side resistance, so ineffective soil is not counted.
map.桩数算出来能直接布桩吗？: Can the computed pile count be used directly for layout?
map.n 仅按上部荷载与单桩 Ra 取整；实际布桩还需考虑承台尺寸、群桩效应、偏心弯矩: n is only rounded up from the superstructure load and single-pile Ra; actual layout must also consider pile cap size, group-pile effect, eccentric moment, settlement and detailing requirements, with an appropriate margin.
